summary: The registrant Copper Property CTL Pass Through Trust filed an 8-K to disclose its monthly report for June 2026 and to announce a routine cash distribution of $0.083641 per trust certificate payable July 10, 2026. There are no merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return program, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change events. The filing is a routine current report providing operational updates and a regular distribution, not a special situation.
